description: Mecklenburg-Vorpommern - Lübtheen - P04 - Satellitenbildkarte - Waldbrand Situation am 30. Satellite image map of the forest fire situation near Lübtheen Mecklenburg-Vorpommern based on optical satellite images of Terra and Aqua (MODIS) from 30 June 2019, 10:27 and 12:11 UTC. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Mecklenburg-Vorpommern - Lübtheen - P04 - Satellite image map - Waldbrand Situation on June 30, 2019" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Kriseninformation, EOC, Lübtheen, DLR, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Deutschland. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read).
